body.p: Mrs. Kessler is a 78-year-old woman who presented with three days of fever, productive cough and shortness of breath. Chest X-ray showed a right lower lobe infiltrate. Oxygen saturation was 89% on room air on arrival. She was treated with intravenous Ceftriaxone and Azithromycin and was weaned off oxygen by hospital day 3. Blood cultures were negative. Her son Alan was updated by phone each day.

Follow up with Dr. Helen Park, primary care, within 1 week. Repeat chest X-ray in 6 weeks. Return to the emergency department for fever above 101 F, worsening shortness of breath or chest pain. Questions: call the discharge nurse line at (740) 555-0150.
